title: Require governed indicator definitions and information-to-action in HMIS
requirements:
- Require an indicator metadata model (numerator, denominator, disaggregation, period, source)
- Add decentralised data use, interpretation and feedback at facility and district levels to the core attributes
- Require separation of core code from governed, versioned configuration packages
- Add governed climate-health indicators, spatial/temporal alignment, uncertainty, thresholds and action protocols
- Define validation by indicator and source with quality flags
- Require versioned reference data and reproducible calculations
- Require national indicator governance to limit proliferation
